shortDescription: Malaysia's King Sultan Ibrahim has decreed that consideration of a request by former premier Najib Razak for a royal pardon be postponed to the next pardons board meeting following a meeting of the board on Friday, the legal affairs division of the prime minister's department said on Friday.
